notes.subject: יֹרֵם … חֵץ
notes.rationale: the plotters' arrow (v. 4) returns: Elohim shoots them with their own weapon; suddenness (פתאם/פתאם) is also mirrored from v. 5.

notes.subject: הָיוּ מַכּוֹתָם
notes.rationale: literally 'they became their wounds' — either 'they became wounds' or 'it (the arrow) became their wounds'; kept the awkward literal 'they become their wounds' as 'they become wounds' with the suffix exposed.

notes.subject: with
notes.rationale: English needs 'with' before the instrument; Hebrew uses a bare accusative.

translation: And Elohim will shoot them ⟨with⟩ an arrow; suddenly they become wounds.
